name: omniswarm
description: Multichain multi-agent security review suite for Solana, NEAR, Rust, Python, TypeScript, and Web3 systems

scripts.check: bash -n bin/audit && bash -n engine/scripts/orchestrate.sh && bash -n engine/scripts/sandbox.sh && npm test
scripts.test:intake: node tools/gate.mjs test:intake apps/api/package.json -- npm test --workspace apps/api
scripts.test:landing: node tools/gate.mjs test:landing apps/web/package.json -- npm test --workspace apps/web
scripts.test:contract: node tools/gate.mjs test:contract contracts/review-registry/Cargo.toml -- cargo test --manifest-path contracts/review-registry/Cargo.toml
scripts.test:e2e: node tools/gate.mjs test:e2e tests/e2e/package.json -- npm test --prefix tests/e2e --
scripts.check:infra: node tools/gate.mjs check:infra infra/check.sh -- bash infra/check.sh
scripts.check:all: npm run test:schemas && npm run test:tools && npm run test:intake && npm run test:landing && npm run test:contract && npm run test:e2e && npm run check:infra && node engine/scripts/harness.mjs --self-test && npm test
scripts.check:w01: node --test engine/scripts/reviewer-*.test.mjs engine/scripts/orchestrator-phases.test.mjs engine/scripts/run-config.test.mjs && node engine/scripts/harness.mjs --self-test && npm test
scripts.check:w02: node engine/scripts/harness.mjs --self-test && npm test && OMNI_REQUIRE_HARDENING=1 node --test engine/scripts/sandbox-hardening.docker.mjs engine/scripts/review-workflow.docker.mjs
scripts.eval:golden: node engine/eval/validate.mjs && node engine/eval/run.mjs && node tools/readme-eval-table.mjs
scripts.check:w10: cargo test --manifest-path contracts/review-registry/Cargo.toml && cargo clippy --manifest-path contracts/review-registry/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && bash contracts/review-registry/scripts/deploy-testnet.sh --dry-run
scripts.check:w11: npm test --workspace apps/web && npm run test:e2e -- landing && npm run guard --workspace apps/web
scripts.check:w13: npm test --workspace packages/guard && npm run typecheck --workspace packages/guard && node packages/guard/demo/attack/run.mjs && node packages/guard/demo/attack/run.mjs --no-guard
